patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Blocks analytics, attribution and crash reporting: Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, AppsFlyer, Bugsnag, ThinkingData, TikTok, Facebook app events and the trackers of Hungry Studio. Turns off their collection flags and removes the advertising id permissions. Login, cloud save, purchases and Remote Config keep working.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes every ad: interstitials, app open ads, banners and rewarded videos. Rewarded ads give their reward instantly, so revives and the other rewards need no video. AppLovin MAX and the ad networks it mediates are never started, and the ad servers are blocked.
